reason: We are putting every rupee aside for the wedding, and ₹22,000 is more than a month of what we earn, or ₹2,000 every month for a year. We wash by hand already and it costs us nothing but time.
objection: The power is not the only problem. Many days there is not enough water in the tank, so even a machine that runs on battery will sit there. And nobody I know has one of these yet.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour had used one for a season and said it really works with little water, and the EMI came down to around ₹1,000 a month after the wedding is done.
